page.layout: One printed page, title page. Centred title block at top, then a short line of italic text, a woodcut vignette in the middle, the imprint centred below it. A handwritten inscription at the foot and a pencilled number at top right are not printed and are not transcribed.
page.notes: The woodcut vignette shows a seated figure beside a tree with a town in the background; no text. The handwritten inscription at the foot ("D. Joanni Rodolpho Stumpfio ... Lanat.") and the pencilled number at top right are manuscript, not printed, and are left out. The "LVDOVICI LAVA-TERI" line has the letters run together in the scan; read as printed. Line breaks follow the printed lines; the title lines contain a hyphen at "LAVA-" and "mi-" as printed.
